# Yangzhou Special Care Daily Products Co., Ltd.

> Leading Chinese manufacturer and exporter of dental care products including toothbrushes, toothpaste, and oral hygiene supplies with OEM and private label capabilities.

Yangzhou Special Care Daily Products Co., Ltd. is a B2B dental care manufacturer based in Yangzhou, Jiangsu, China, specializing in toothbrushes (electric, bamboo, kids, adult, travel, baby), toothpaste, teeth strips, and dental floss. The company offers OEM manufacturing, private label solutions, and wholesale distribution to North America, South America, Southeast Asia, and other global markets.
